test: decompengine.acp.AcpAgentHarnessTest.public ACP reconstruction enforces mutation grants and preserves publication on limit outcomes
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild --tests 'decompengine.acp.AcpAgentHarnessTest.public ACP reconstruction enforces mutation grants and preserves publication on limit outcomes'

scope.cancellation: The test interrupts the public reconstruction worker exactly once after the fixture emits its readiness event following the successful target-write acknowledgement.
scope.receipt: The invocation-bound receipt is request-bound and returned with stopReason CANCELLED; reconstruction raises ModuleReconstructionInterruptedException(CANCELLED).
scope.rollback: Previously accepted output metadata and bytes remain identical; no publication residue remains.
scope.cleanup: Process is stopped, no owned processes remain, sandbox cleanup is verified.
qualificationLimits: does not establish session/cancel method delivery
does not qualify repeated interrupts or concurrent failures
does not inspect persisted interruption-report contents
